## 1. Executive Summary

The end-to-end (E2E) and integration test harness for the SOFC Monitoring System production frontend has been fully constructed, verified, and integrated into the continuous integration workflow. The test suite covers all four requirements (R1: Database Explorer, R2: Aspen Integration, R3: AI Energy Management System, R4: System Integration, Navigation & Types) across all four test tiers (Tier 1: Unit & Component Isolation, Tier 2: Feature & State Integration, Tier 3: Router & E2E Flows, Tier 4: System Invariants & Production Build).

### Test Suite Execution Summary
- **Test Runner:** Vitest v2.1.9 with JSDOM environment and React Testing Library
- **Total Test Files:** 12 passed / 12 total (100%)
- **Total Tests:** 113 passed / 113 total (100%)
- **TypeScript Typecheck:** Clean (`tsc --noEmit`, 0 errors)
- **Production Bundle:** Clean (`vite build`, chunk split into `vendor`, `charts`, `index`)

## 2. Test Execution Commands

All commands are executed from the `frontend/` directory:

| Task | Command | Target / Assertion |
|------|---------|--------------------|
| **Run Complete Test Suite** | `cd frontend && npm test` | Runs all 12 test suites across unit, integration, and E2E scenarios |
| **Run Database Explorer Tests** | `cd frontend && npx vitest run src/test/database.test.tsx` | Tests Features 1–4 (Connection health, collection browser, JSON inspector, flush/reconnect) |
| **Run Aspen Integration Tests** | `cd frontend && npx vitest run src/test/aspen.test.tsx` | Tests Features 5–8 (Status & twin mode, 10-node baseline tolerances, PR-BM reconciliation, optimizer) |
| **Run AI EMS Tests** | `cd frontend && npx vitest run src/test/ems.test.tsx` | Tests Features 9–13 (24h predictive load, TOU tariffs, degradation horizon, dispatch table, advisory cards) |
| **Run Navigation & Router Tests** | `cd frontend && npx vitest run src/test/navigation.test.tsx` | Tests Feature 14 (Sidebar 6 links, active link classes, route resolution, WebSocket liveness) |
| **Run Real-World Scenarios** | `cd frontend && npx vitest run src/test/e2e_scenarios.test.tsx` | Tests Scenarios 1–5 (Operator flow, plant engineer flow, energy manager flow, offline resilience) |
| **Type Integrity Check** | `cd frontend && npm run typecheck` | Validates TypeScript contracts across all interfaces without compilation errors |
| **Production Build Validation** | `cd frontend && npm run build` | Compiles and tree-shakes production assets to `dist/` |
